memory: Yeah, staying healthy is definitely a priority for me these days. I’m in my mid-50s now, and I’ve realized that little lifestyle changes make a huge difference. Living in Kansas means dealing with unpredictable weather, so my routine has to be flexible. Some days, I can get outside and go for a long walk, but other times, I’m stuck inside thanks to the freezing winters or the crazy Midwest storms. Still, I do my best to stay active, eat right, and manage my stress levels. It’s all about balance!Let me break it down for you. My biggest focus right now is on maintaining a good diet. Since I have Type 2 Diabetes, I have to be careful with my carb intake. I used to love pasta and bread, but now I’ve learned to swap them out for healthier options—whole grains, lean proteins, and lots of veggies. I won’t lie, it was hard at first, but now it’s just second nature. My go-to breakfast is usually Greek yogurt with nuts and berries or eggs with avocado. Lunch is something simple, like grilled chicken and a salad. And dinner? I love making soups, especially in the winter—there’s nothing better than a warm bowl of homemade vegetable soup when it’s freezing outside!Let me break it down for you.
